name: independent_judge_reference_subset_screen
predecessor: P044 failed frozen gates because other-attribute identity calibration was 92% and clean-both was 9%; no training
hypothesis: If the reference-subset signal is not an artifact of the 7B judge, an independently parameterized 3B judge should satisfy the same controls and routing gates and agree on at least 70% of the 200 true relation decisions.
novelty_boundary: MPCIR 2026 already decomposes and routes text/reference/target noise in single-reference CIR, and HUG 2026 models fine-grained heterogeneous CIR uncertainty. The only candidate increment is a reliability lattice over separately instructed visual-reference roles in multi-image CIR, with subset-specific supervision and real PinPoint transfer.
go_rule: All four calibration checks must pass >=95%; at least 50% of bundles must have one or both valid role relations, at least 20% must have exactly one valid role, at least 10% must have both, and each one-sided branch must contain >=5%. All gates are required. In addition, the 3B judge must agree with the frozen 7B judge on at least 70% of the 200 role-relation decisions.
interpretation: A pass supports judge-robust development viability only. It still cannot authorize training; a product-disjoint data confirmation is required next.
